about.headline: Technology That Works the Way Your Business Actually Runs.
about.p1: Entrpryz was founded on one idea: technology should make business simpler, not more complicated. We help businesses fix, build and modernize the systems they run on — without the jargon or the overhead.
about.p2: We start from how your business actually works — then select the right platforms, roll them out properly, and make sure your team actually uses them.

howWeWork.headline: We Don't Start With a Product. We Start With Your Problem.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: We start with your business, your goals, and where things are actually breaking down — not a product pitch.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: We look at your data, your systems, and your day-to-day workflow to find where the real opportunity is.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We design a solution that fits your business and your budget — not the most complicated option available.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: We build, integrate, test and roll it out — and make sure your team actually adopts it.

steps.title: Evolve
steps.description: We keep improving the system as your business grows, instead of walking away at go-live.

founder.name: Javed Ahmad Qureshi
founder.p1: 25+ years of hands-on experience across enterprise systems, ERP delivery, and IT leadership — including 18+ years leading ERP programs and 14+ years in senior technology roles (CIO, Vice President, Senior Manager).
founder.p2: Currently serving as CIO for a real estate development and hospitality group across Pakistan and the UAE. Over his career, he has directed 65+ ERP implementations across manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, retail, insurance, utilities, and non-profits — including major power utility billing modernizations.
founder.p3: Known for keeping IT spending tightly aligned with business and audit needs — building the cloud, security controls, and ERP workflows that hold up under real management and external audit scrutiny.
founder.philosophy: technology should make business simpler, faster, and better — not more complicated.

careerTimeline.overview: Directing a cross-border Enterprise Technology department of 8–10 engineers and specialists, owning an ~$80,000+ annual IT operational budget and supporting 150+ IT users across ~200 employees in Pakistan and Dubai.
Led ERP turnaround projects, systems audits, and post-implementation reviews for mid-market industrial and public sector clients.

Recruited as Keystone's founding NetSuite lead, building Pakistan's first Oracle NetSuite practice from scratch. Hired and trained a 10–15 person delivery team that executed 15+ full-cycle implementations for clients of varying scale.
Directed SAP Business One implementations and custom add-on engineering for 50+ enterprises. Managed major utility ERP programs with combined project value of ~PKR 600 Million.
Led in-house ERP deployments and software engineering across pharmaceutical and packaging manufacturing, including a fully in-house SAP Business One migration and custom DMS build.
